chunks: And Hārūn ibn Khārijah narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“When it is the middle of Shaʿbān, a caller from the highest horizon calls out: O visitors of the grave of al-Ḥusayn, return forgiven; your reward is with your Lord and Muḥammad, your Prophet.”

key_terms.النِّصْفُ: the middle point, here referring to the middle night or day of Shaʿbān
key_terms.الْأُفُقِ الْأَعْلَى: the highest horizon, indicating an exalted heavenly source of the call
key_terms.ثَوَابُكُمْ: your reward or recompense from Allah
key_terms.شَعْبَانَ: the month of Shaʿbān in the Islamic calendar
key_terms.قَبْرِ الْحُسَيْنِ: the grave of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام
key_terms.مُنَادٍ: a caller or announcer making a proclamation

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام on the middle of Shaʿbān?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks of the great merit of visiting the grave of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, especially by the middle of Shaʿbān. It describes a heavenly proclamation granting forgiveness to the visitors and assuring them that their reward is entrusted to Allah and to Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, their Prophet.
